question: Should OpenClaw accept purpose-specific memory role slots as the public config/plugin API direction for memory composition?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the limitation, but the requested fix adds public config keys, per-agent semantics, and plugin lifecycle behavior across multiple memory roles, so maintainer product/API intent is required before implementation or closure.

options.title: Review the role-slot PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers evaluate the linked implementation candidate as the canonical design path.

options.title: Narrow the plugin seam
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a smaller design that separates non-runtime memory tools from the exclusive memory runtime slot without all proposed roles.

options.title: Reject core role slots
options.body: Close only after a maintainer explicitly decides memory-role composition should remain outside OpenClaw core or live entirely in external plugins.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers evaluate the linked implementation candidate as the canonical design path.
